entries.jp: {v:001A}それを使って、{n}{s:0025}を倒せるはずだったんだが、{n}そこまでには至らなかった。
entries.en: {v:001A}We were supposed to be able to defeat {s:0025}{n}with it, but it didn't go that far.

entries.jp: {v:001B}至らなかったということは、{n}何らかの効果があったんだね？
entries.en: {v:001B}If it did not go that far, then it did have some effect?

entries.jp: {v:001C}そうなの！{p}{v:001D}あいつの回復力って知ってる？{n}切った端から傷がつながっちゃうんだよ？{n}でもそれがなくなっちゃったの！
entries.en: {v:001C}That's right!{p}{v:001D}You know how fast he heals? His wounds close up the{n}instant you cut him! Well, he can't do that anymore!

entries.jp: {v:001E}つまり、今の彼はけっして不死身じゃないの。{n}ダメージを与え続ければ、いずれは勝てる{n}‥‥はずだったんだけど。
entries.en: {v:001E}In other words, he's certainly not invincible now. If we{n}keep hurting him, we should eventually win... Or so{n}we thought.

entries.jp: {v:001F}だけど？
entries.en: {v:001F}But?

entries.jp: {v:0020}テレポートで逃げられちゃうの‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0020}He keeps escaping with Teleport...

entries.jp: {v:0021}たぶん、時空を操る能力が生きているんだ。{n}だから瞬時にどこへでも逃げられる。
entries.en: {v:0021}His ability to control space-time probably still works.{n}That lets him escape anywhere in an instant.

entries.jp: {v:0022}そう悲観することはない。{p}{v:0023}我々でも倒せるという可能性が出たんだからね。
entries.en: {v:0022}There is no need to be so pessimistic.{p}{v:0023}We now know we may be able to defeat him ourselves.

entries.jp: {v:0024}何度逃げられても、いつかは倒せるはず。
entries.en: {v:0024}However many times he escapes, we should be able to{n}defeat him someday.

entries.jp: {v:0025}そういうことだ。{p}{v:0026}とにかくこれを報告に来たんだ。
entries.en: {v:0025}That's right.{p}{v:0026}Anyway, that's what we came to report.

entries.jp: {v:0027}あいつったら、ちっちゃい{s:0119}を兵隊に{n}使ってるけど、それは自分自身が{n}無敵じゃなくなっちゃったからだよね。
entries.en: {v:0027}He's using little creatures like {s:0119} as{n}soldiers, but that's because he's not invincible himself{n}anymore, right?
{v:0028}Little creatures like {s:0119}? Those{n}monsters...

entries.jp: {v:0029}ああ。{n}魔法学院も襲われた。
entries.en: {v:0029}Yeah. They attacked the Magic Academy, too.

entries.jp: {v:002A}学院もか‥‥。
entries.en: {v:002A}The Academy, too...

entries.jp: {v:002B}さて、後は魔法学院にも教えておかないとね？
entries.en: {v:002B}Well, we still need to tell the Magic Academy, don't we?

entries.jp: {v:002C}あそこも狙われそうですからね‥‥。
entries.en: {v:002C}It seems likely to be targeted, too...

entries.jp: {v:002E}いろいろと、ありがとう。{n}これで奴を倒す希望がわいてきたよ。
entries.en: {v:002E}Thank you for everything. You have given me hope{n}that we can defeat him.

entries.jp: {v:0003}さっそく話ってのを始めようじゃねぇか。
entries.en: {v:0003}Let's get this talk started, then.

entries.jp: {v:0004}そうですね。{p}{v:0005}まず、今までの所をもう一度確認し、{n}それからしかるべき対応策を考えるということで。
entries.en: {v:0004}Yes.{p}{v:0005}First, let us review what has happened so far. Then we{n}can consider how best to respond.

entries.jp: {v:0006}ええと、まず私たちがパワーストーンで、{n}{s:0025}の超回復能力を防ぎました。
entries.en: {v:0006}Um, first, we used the Power Stone to stop{n}{s:0025}'s extraordinary regeneration.

entries.jp: {v:0007}後は、どうやって奴のテレポートを防ぐ‥‥
entries.en: {v:0007}Now we just need a way to stop him using Teleport...

entries.jp: {FFEE}{v:0008}　　　　　　聞こえているか！{n}　　　　　　愚かな人間どもよ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}{v:0008}　　　　　　Can you hear me, foolish humans?!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0009}この声は、奴か！？
entries.en: {v:0009}That voice! Is it him?!

entries.jp: {FFEE}{v:000A}　　　愚かな人間どもよ！{n}　　　よく聞くがいい！{p}{v:000B}　　　私は今まで{s:005C}や魔法使い以外には{n}　　　攻撃を仕掛けなかった。{n}　　　それは来たるべき我が支配のためだ。{n}　　　だが一部の愚か者のために、{n}　　　私の気が変わりかけている。{p}{v:000C}　　　そうだ。{n}　　　これからは無差別に人間を殺す。{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}{v:000A}　　　Foolish humans! Listen well!{p}{v:000B}Until now, I have attacked only those in the {s:005C}{n}ranks and those who practice magic. This was for the{n}sake of my coming reign.{p}But certain fools are beginning to change my mind.{p}{v:000C}Yes. From now on, I shall kill humans indiscriminately.{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:000D}なんだと！？
entries.en: {v:000D}What?!

entries.jp: {FFEE}{v:000E}　　それを望まないなら、すぐさま我に屈せよ！{p}{v:000F}　　だが、考えをまとめる時間も必要だろう。{n}そこで寛大な私は、数日だけ待ってやることにした。{p}{v:0010}　　まずは、パワーストーンを差し出せ！{n}　　それさえも拒むというなら、{n}　　この場で村１つを吹き飛ばしてやる！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}{v:000E}　　If you do not wish that, submit to me at once!{p}{v:000F}But you will need time to make up your minds. In my{n}generosity, I have decided to grant you a few days.{p}{v:0010}First, surrender the Power Stone! If you refuse even{n}that, I shall obliterate a village here and now!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0011}奴め、どこかの村を人質に取っているのか？
entries.en: {v:0011}Has the bastard taken some village hostage?

entries.jp: {FFEE}{v:0012}　　　さあ、パワーストーンを持って、{n}　　　{s:015A}村まで来い。{n}　急いでこなければ、私の気が変わるかも知れんぞ？{p}　　　‥‥{v:0013}わっはっはっはっはっ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}{v:0012}　　　Now, bring the Power Stone to {s:015A}{n}Village. Hurry, or I may change my mind.{p}...{v:0013}Wahahahaha!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:0014}村のみんなが‥‥人質に？
entries.en: {v:0014}Everyone in the village... taken hostage?
{v:0015}Your village, {s:0003}... taken hostage?

entries.jp: {v:0016}ねぇ、どうするのよ！
entries.en: {v:0016}Hey, what are we going to do?!

entries.jp: {v:0017}どうするってもな‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0017}What can we do...?

entries.jp: パワーストーンを渡しますか？
entries.en: Will you hand over the Power Stone?

entries.jp: ・渡す
entries.en: ・Hand it over

entries.jp: ・渡さない
entries.en: ・Don't hand it over

entries.jp: ・みんなに任せる
entries.en: ・Let everyone else decide

entries.jp: {v:0018}そりゃ、もうパワーストーンにエネルギーは{n}残ってないけどさ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0018}Sure, the Power Stone doesn't have any energy{n}left, but...

entries.jp: {v:0019}それで人々が助かるなら、私も渡すべきだと思います。
entries.en: {v:0019}If it will save those people, I too think we should hand{n}it over.

entries.jp: {v:001A}かといって、渡してしまうのはどうでしょう？{n}数十年たてば、エネルギーは補充できるんでしょ？
entries.en: {v:001A}Even so, should we really hand it over? Its energy can{n}be replenished in a few decades, can't it?

entries.jp: {v:001B}そう言われると、う～ん‥‥。
entries.en: {v:001B}When you put it that way, hmm...

entries.jp: {v:001C}俺は渡さない方がいいと思うぜ。{n}奴が約束を守るとは思えねぇ。
entries.en: {v:001C}I say we don't hand it over. I don't trust him to keep{n}his word.

entries.jp: {v:001D}{s:0003}さんはどう思うの？
entries.en: {v:001D}What do you think, {s:0003}?

entries.jp: {v:001E}確かに村の人々のことは心配です。{n}でも、そのために{s:0025}を倒す決定的手段を{n}手放してしまうというのは‥‥。{p}{v:001F}こんな時、フェザリアンなら、{n}確実に『渡さない』と言い張るでしょうね。
entries.en: {v:001E}Of course I am worried about the villagers. But to give{n}up our surest means of defeating {s:0025}{n}for their sake...{p}{v:001F}In a situation like this, the Featherians would certainly{n}insist on refusing.

entries.jp: {v:0020}{s:015A}のみんなが、どうなってもいいの？
entries.en: {v:0020}You don't care what happens to everyone in{n}{s:015A}?

entries.jp: {v:0023}冷たいことをいうようだが、{n}ここで奴を倒す決定力を失うのはどうかと思う。{p}{v:0024}少数の者を救って、{n}多くを犠牲にさらすことにはなるまいか？
entries.en: {v:0023}This may sound heartless, but I question the wisdom of{n}giving up our decisive advantage against him now.{p}{v:0024}Would we not be saving a few at the cost of{n}endangering many?

entries.jp: {v:0025}ちょっと、責任逃れはなしじゃない？
entries.en: {v:0025}Hey, you can't just dodge the responsibility!

entries.jp: {v:0026}確かに難しい問題ですけど‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0026}It certainly is a difficult decision, but...

entries.jp: {v:0027}要は{s:0025}の野郎を{n}信じられるかどうかって事だな。
entries.en: {v:0027}It all comes down to whether we can trust that{n}bastard {s:0025}.

entries.jp: {v:0028}俺なら渡さないね。{n}どうせ渡したところで、{n}村に手を出さない保証はねぇ。{p}{v:0029}そして何より、奴は{s:0001}からグローシュを{n}奪った張本人だ。{n}信じられねぇよ。
entries.en: {v:0028}I wouldn't hand it over. Even if we did, there's no{n}guarantee he'd leave the village alone.{p}{v:0029}Above all, he's the one who stole {s:0001}'s{n}Grosh. I can't trust him.

entries.jp: {v:002A}わたしは‥‥村のみんなを助けるためなら、{n}仕方ないんじゃないかって‥‥。
entries.en: {v:002A}I... If it's to save everyone in the village, maybe we{n}don't have a choice...

entries.jp: {v:002B}冷たいようだが、私は渡さない方がいいと思う。{p}{v:002C}奴が村に手出ししないという確証がない以上、{n}切り札を渡すことには反対だ。
entries.en: {v:002B}It may sound heartless, but I believe we{n}should refuse.{p}{v:002C}Without any assurance that he will spare the village, I{n}oppose giving him our trump card.

entries.jp: {v:002D}俺も同感だ。{n}渡すべきじゃないと思う。
entries.en: {v:002D}I agree. We shouldn't hand it over.

entries.jp: {v:002E}２人はどう思いますか？
entries.en: {v:002E}What do you two think?

entries.jp: {v:002F}渡すべきではないでしょうな。
entries.en: {v:002F}I would say we ought not hand it over.

entries.jp: {v:0030}私も{s:0025}を信用できません。
entries.en: {v:0030}I cannot trust {s:0025} either.
{v:0031}So, what will you do, {s:0004}?

entries.jp: {v:0032}わかりました。{n}パワーストーンは渡しません。{p}{v:0033}代わりに我々で何とかする手段を‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0032}Very well. We will not hand over the Power Stone.{p}{v:0033}Instead, we must find some way to resolve{n}this ourselves...

entries.jp: {v:0034}大変です陛下！
entries.en: {v:0034}Your Majesty! An emergency!

entries.jp: {v:0035}どうしたのですか？
entries.en: {v:0035}What has happened?

entries.en: {v:0036}The {s:00AE} crowds... The {s:00AE}{n}crowds are storming the castle, demanding that we{n}obey {s:0025}!
{v:0038}Right!

entries.jp: {s:0154}は‥‥、{n}{s:0154}は無事なのか！？{p}この距離をすぐにでも越えて行けたら‥‥。
entries.en: {s:0154}... Is {s:0154} safe?!{p}If only I could cross this distance in an instant...

entries.jp: こんな時、何もできない自分がうらめしい‥‥。
entries.en: I despise my own helplessness at a time like this...

entries.jp: 事態はなかなか好転しないね‥‥。
entries.en: Things just aren't getting any better...

entries.en: {s:0025} has done this to our people, and to{n}my friend...{p}I cannot forgive him. ...Never!

entries.jp: ‥‥{s:0025}め！{n}よくもやってくれたな‥‥。{p}それより、お前たちならすぐに{n}{s:015A}村へ向かえるだろう？{n}村の様子を見に行ってくれないか？
entries.en: ...Damn you, {s:0025}! How dare you...{p}But you can reach {s:015A} Village at once,{n}can you not? Would you go and see how the villagers{n}are faring?

entries.en: Do you need my help?

entries.en: But that would be too many of us. Someone will have to{n}leave the party.

entries.en: {n}　　　　{FFEF}{s:0008} joined the party!{FFF1}

entries.jp: 頼りにしてくれ。
entries.en: You can count on me.

entries.jp: 早く平和を取り戻したい‥‥。
entries.en: I hope we can restore peace soon...

entries.jp: これ以上、国民に不安を与えてはおけぬ。{n}早急に事態を解決せねば‥‥。
entries.en: We cannot let our people live in fear any longer. We{n}must resolve this swiftly...

entries.jp: まさか‥‥。{n}こんな事になるとは‥‥。
entries.en: I never imagined... it would come to this...

What?! {s:0153} too?

entries.en: I hear that {s:000A} and {s:0153}{n}are missing. {s:0151} reported it to me a{n}little while ago... I hope nothing is wrong...

entries.jp: 僕の力が必要ですか？
entries.en: Do you need my help?

entries.jp: {n}　　　　{FFEF}{s:0004}が仲間になった！{FFF1}
entries.en: {n}　　　　{FFEF}{s:0004} joined the party!{FFF1}

entries.jp: はりきって行きましょう！

entries.en: How can we corner {s:0025}?

entries.en: ...When will the world finally know peace?

entries.en: I cannot leave my post, so I must leave this to you.

entries.en: {n}　　　　　　　It's locked!

entries.en: ...I'm concentrating. Please don't speak to me.

{v:0002}What's this?!

entries.en: {v:0003}Ah, someone's lying over there!

entries.en: {n}　　　　Obtained '{FFEF}{s:000E}'s Potential 7{FFF1}'!

entries.jp: 他人の国へ来ているんだぞ。{n}礼儀を重んじるのも騎士のつとめだ。{p}テレポートを使いたいなら、{n}城の外へ出てからにしろ。
entries.en: We are guests in another country. Observing proper{n}etiquette is also a knight's duty.{p}If you wish to use Teleport, leave the castle first.
